correctness.rationale: The holomorphic differential basis is complete by genus three; the standard Cartier coefficient rule is applied to the two congruence classes p modulo six. Lucas congruences imply exact endpoint factors; the Gegenbauer differential equation and bounded-degree uniqueness identify the common coefficient polynomial. Its leading and endpoint binomial coefficients are nonzero, and separability follows from the differential equation at non-singular roots. Stable Cartier ranks and the elliptic quotient/Prym isogeny give all rank, a-number, Newton slope assertions. Exact standalone modular polynomial checks passed for 44 primes up to 199; those finite checks do not replace the all-prime proof.
